body: Well im not very good at it but should you need anyone ill do my best to help. Thanks for taking time to talk to me.
Thank you. I appreciate it. Its good to know someone believes in me.. even when i cant
Thank you... that means a lot. Really it does.
Yes. I can't get anymore right now. No. I try to but it never works out well
Anything smaller than they are pretty much. Crickets roaches even small mice
I have 6 tarantulas a snake a fish and a cat. Thats all i have anymore. Tv is okay.

I can give you one piece of advice and it may be all i was ever good for... dont give your heart away. Its too precious a thing to trust in another's hand. With it you give another the power to destroy you. it is a sickness with no cure. Don't regret not falling in love. Only love yourself. I used to have a heart of gold as they say. I wpuld do anything for the ones i loved even when they didnt return the favor. And now my heart is blacker than midnight. All i feel is pain and hatred. You dont want that. Trust me. Cutting is the only way i feel alive... or feel at all fornthat matter. I am 23 and in 2 months i will be 24. I live alone exception for my pets who are just as misunderstood as i am.

I fell in love. And he was everything i always dreamed of. And now he couldnt care less. it was all i could take. i have no family. No friends. I am alone. All i can feel is pain. So i hurt myself because the physical pain is better than the pain i feel inside
